current.text: Portland's backcourt is crowded with on-ball guards: Lillard, Morant and Henderson are back, with Avdija and others also handling the ball.
Portland is thin at forward. Avdija and Camara are basically the only forwards after the team lost Grant, Thybulle, Murray, Love and Wesley.
He is not in Portland's projected starting five of Lillard, Morant, Camara, Avdija and Clingan.
Minutes and usage are expected to swing from game to game across Portland's rotation.

note: He is not a draft target for us. Both Yahoo and ESPN value him at 0 USD, he ranks 280 on Yahoo and 201 on ESPN, and our 144-player draft will not reach him. The projections disagree a lot: Yahoo has him at 39.8% FG and ESPN has him at 49.6% FG with more minutes. No category stands out, so he fits no particular build. Early in the season, check whether Portland's thin forward group gives him steady minutes before you spend any FAB on him.
